messages.author: Andriy Kovalenko
messages.body:
Hello,
At present, I have installed Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS on my Dell Precision Tower
5810 desktop from scratch, and have now been installing Amber24 and
AmberTools24.
Running *./run_cmake* (please see attached) succeeded in part.
Running *make Install* (please see attached) ended up with:
CMake Error at
/home/andriy/amber24_src/cmake/Replace-function.cmake:32 (file):
file failed to open for reading (No such file or directory):
/home/andriy/amber24//miniconda/lib/python3.12/site-packages/conda_build/convert.py
Call Stack (most recent call first):
/home/andriy/amber24_src/cmake/FixCondaShebang/FixCondaShebang.cmake:48
(configuretime_file_replace)
Searching in amberarchives produced little.
Could you please advise how to resolve this issue?
Sincerely,
Dr. Andriy Kovalenko
Research Assistant
Department of Biological Sciences
University of Alberta
CW 405, Biological Sciences Bldg.
Edmonton, Alberta, Canada T6G 2E9
Tel: 780-940-7477 (cell)
e-mail: andriy.kovalenko.ualberta.ca
